name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 1998 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 1998 record supports: the thirteen CERT/CC advisories CA-1998-01 to CA-1998-13 (smurf floods, the BIND, NIS+, qpopper, IMAP, ToolTalk and mountd overflows, the MIME client overflow and the BSD stack crashes), the seven incident notes IN-98.01 to IN-98-07 (IRIX default-account sweeps, the mscan scanner, the 186,126-account password haul, scripted mountd attacks and Remote Explorer), the Microsoft bulletins of the year with MS98-010 on Back Orifice and cDc's own release pages, the F-Secure descriptions of CIH and Marburg, and the 2017 Moonlight Maze research on the HRTest relay and LOKI2. No 1998 source prints an ATT&CK id: every entry is this study's later mapping. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_1998.md. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
